INSERT INTO STD_SSDM_DOC (SSN, PERSON_ZIP_AT_DEATH, SSDM_FILE, MATCH_PASS, BIRTH_YEAR, LNAME, SUFFIX, FNAME, MNAME, PERSON_COUNTY_AT_DEATH, MATCH_CD, PERSON_STATE_AT_DEATH, REVIEW_UID, DOB_TEXT, DOD_TEXT, MATCHED_STATENO, EHARS_STATUS_CD, MATCH_WEIGHT, DOCUMENT_ID, SSDM_SRC_ID, AGE_AT_DEATH, CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS, QS_PARENT_DOC_ID, REVIEW_DATE, CREATE_DATE, EHARS_IMPORT_DATE, MATCHED_PROCESS_DATE, CREATE_UID, ORIG_LNAME, HASH_NUMBER)
SELECT
CASE WHEN LENGTH (SSN) < '9' THEN '' WHEN UPPER (SSN) != LOWER (SSN) THEN '' WHEN SSN like '%00000%' or SSN like '%11111%' or SSN like '%22222%' or SSN like '%33333%' or SSN like '%44444%' or SSN like '%55555%' or SSN like '%66666%' or SSN like '%77777%' or SSN like '%88888%' or SSN like '%99999%' THEN '' WHEN LENGTH (SSN) = '9' THEN SSN ELSE '' END, TRIM (UPPER (ZIP)), TRIM (SSDM_FILE), NULL, TRIM (UPPER (BTHYEAR)), TRIM (UPPER (LASTNAME)), TRIM (UPPER (NSUFFIX)), TRIM (UPPER (FIRSTNAME)), TRIM (UPPER (MIDDLENAME)), NULL, NULL, TRIM (UPPER (STZ)), NULL,
case when BTHDATE is not null and fn_to_Date(TRIM (BTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY') is not null then TO_CHAR (fn_TO_DATE (TRIM (BTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY'), 'MM/DD/YYYY') when BTHDATE is not null and fn_to_Date(TRIM (BTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY') is null and length(BTHDATE) = 8 then REPLACE(substr(BTHDATE, 1,2), '00','..') || '/' || replace(substr(BTHDATE, 3,2), '00','..') || '/' || replace(substr(BTHDATE, 5,4), '00','..') else null end,
case when DTHDATE is not null and fn_to_Date(TRIM (DTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY') is not null then TO_CHAR (fn_TO_DATE (TRIM (DTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY'), 'MM/DD/YYYY') when DTHDATE is not null and fn_to_Date(TRIM (DTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY') is null and length(DTHDATE) = 8 then REPLACE(substr(DTHDATE, 1,2), '00','..') || '/' || replace(substr(DTHDATE, 3,2), '00','..') || '/' || replace(substr(DTHDATE, 5,4), '00','..') else null end, NULL, NULL, NULL, DOCUMENT_ID, SSDM_SRC_ID, AGEDEATH, 5, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, TRIM (UPPER (ORIGLNAME)), ORA_HASH ( TRIM (UPPER (LASTNAME)) || TRIM (UPPER (FIRSTNAME)) || case when BTHDATE is not null and fn_to_Date(TRIM (BTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY') is not null then TO_CHAR (fn_TO_DATE (TRIM (BTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY'), 'MM/DD/YYYY') when BTHDATE is not null and fn_to_Date(TRIM (BTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY') is null and length(BTHDATE) = 8 then REPLACE(substr(BTHDATE, 1,2), '00','..') || '/' || replace(substr(BTHDATE, 3,2), '00','..') || '/' || replace(substr(BTHDATE, 5,4), '00','..') else null end || case when DTHDATE is not null and fn_to_Date(TRIM (DTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY') is not null then TO_CHAR (fn_TO_DATE (TRIM (DTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY'), 'MM/DD/YYYY') when DTHDATE is not null and fn_to_Date(TRIM (DTHDATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY') is null and length(DTHDATE) = 8 then REPLACE(substr(DTHDATE, 1,2), '00','..') || '/' || replace(substr(DTHDATE, 3,2), '00','..') || '/' || replace(substr(DTHDATE, 5,4), '00','..') else null end || TRIM (UPPER (SSN)) || TRIM (UPPER (NSUFFIX))) FROM raw_ssdm_doc WHERE current_process_Status = 1
